# Ugle

> Find the exact moment inside any recording, locally on your machine, with no uploads and no cloud.

Ugle is a local-first search application for media professionals, newsrooms, journalists, and podcast producers. It indexes video and audio archives directly on-device with sub-30ms search, 90+ supported languages, and zero cloud uploads.

## Core Pages

- [Overview](https://ugle.ai/): Product overview, key differentiators, and features.
- [How It Works](https://ugle.ai/how-it-works): On-device transcription, local search index, and precision timestamp clip extraction.
- [Pricing](https://ugle.ai/pricing): Solo and Team annual/monthly licences, zero cloud fees, and educational access.
- [Download](https://ugle.ai/download): Desktop installers for macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel) and Windows (64-bit).
- [Security & Privacy](https://ugle.ai/security): 100% private architecture, zero cloud telemetry, and local storage details.
- [About Us](https://ugle.ai/about): Company mission, team, and local-first software philosophy.
- [Changelog](https://ugle.ai/changelog): Product updates, engine enhancements, and release notes.

## Use Cases

- [Newsrooms](https://ugle.ai/use-cases/newsrooms): Fast soundbite search and segment clipping before broadcast deadlines.
- [Podcast Producers](https://ugle.ai/use-cases/podcasts): Search across full back-catalogues of episodes without re-listening.
- [Journalists](https://ugle.ai/use-cases/journalists): Confidential, searchable archives of source interviews and recordings.
